summary: AI tools cannot be listed as authors. Authors who used AI in preparing a manuscript, including drafting or editing text, must briefly describe that use during submission and are solely accountable for fact-checking AI output. Reviewers must write their own evaluation, may use only AI tools that guarantee the manuscript won't be used for training, and must disclose any AI use in their cover letter.
